posts.subject: Slays
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Admin Community.


I have seen that people die every 2nd round on minigames for no reason and It's been happening quiet a bit now since awp_submarine ( few maps before ) and when I did !music it carried on playing.


@Nachtfrische
@BlackFire
@Sky

@Nachtfrische and me already noticed that problem.
The problem is caused by the new Autorespawn-Plugin. All maps which have rotating objects in it, will have this error.
Since it happens only once or not that often in common, we decided to leave it for now but we still search for a solution, of course.

@CyberTroniX hit the nail on the head.
Me and him were testing a new autorespawn plugin for the course maps, which automatically respawns all players who die and then automatically stops, after it has detected an AFK killer.
However, on some maps like "mg_hype_v2c", it kills people every two rounds in the spawn area. But since it's not that big of a problem, just causes minor waiting times and is not present on every map, but provides a huge benefit to all course maps, we've decided to keep the plugin.


Furthermore, there was a new update for the plugin released today, which may or may not have fixed the issue. I've installed and tested the plugin just now and couldn't see any issues on "mg_hype_v2c". Potentially, it could've fixed the issue.
Please give your feedback in this thread on whether or not the issue was fixed, thanks.
ahhhh I see now, thank you for clearing this for me.

UPDATE: The new version has a bug that was not present in the old version and it makes maps like "mg_swag_multigames_v7" unplayable.
Therefore, the entire plugin will be removed until a bug free version is released.
